summary: Controls and queries UVC PTZ webcams and USB video capture cameras (Pan, Tilt, Zoom, Focus, Exposure, Brightness) via native Apple IOKit USB framework bridge.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable live camera monitoring and control.

ports.name: Camera Target
ports.text: Target UVC camera selected from connected devices.

ports.name: Poll Rate (Hz)
ports.text: Frequency in Hz for native hardware property polling.

ports.name: Command
ports.text: JSON command string/object for programmatic camera control (e.g. set_value, get_value).

ports.name: Trigger Command
ports.text: Fires execution of the JSON Command.

ports.name: Set Pan
ports.text: Absolute Pan angle value to write to the camera.

ports.name: Set Tilt
ports.text: Absolute Tilt angle value to write to the camera.

ports.name: Send Pan/Tilt
ports.text: Trigger to write Set Pan and Set Tilt values to the hardware.

ports.name: Set Zoom
ports.text: Zoom value to write to the camera.

ports.name: Send Zoom
ports.text: Trigger to write Zoom value to the hardware.

ports.name: Set Focus
ports.text: Focus value to write to the camera.

ports.name: Send Focus
ports.text: Trigger to write Focus value to the hardware.

ports.name: Set Exposure
ports.text: Exposure time value to write to the camera.

ports.name: Send Exposure
ports.text: Trigger to write Exposure time to the hardware.

ports.name: Set Brightness
ports.text: Brightness value to write to the camera.

ports.name: Send Brightness
ports.text: Trigger to write Brightness value to the hardware.

ports.name: Reset Defaults
ports.text: Resets all supported controls to their hardware defaults.

ports.name: Trigger Out
ports.text: Fires on every property update or poll cycle.

ports.name: Result Object
ports.text: Full raw array of all control states.

ports.name: Properties Object
ports.text: Key-value dictionary mapping control names to their current values.

ports.name: Controls List
ports.text: List of all supported controls with their min, max, step, and default metadata.

ports.name: Pan
ports.text: Current Pan value from the camera.

ports.name: Tilt
ports.text: Current Tilt value from the camera.

ports.name: Zoom
ports.text: Current Zoom value from the camera.

ports.name: Focus
ports.text: Current Focus value from the camera.

ports.name: Exposure
ports.text: Current Exposure value from the camera.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True when the native polling thread is active.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Current operational status string.
